info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Servicing By Param1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the retrieval of case root cause analysis information based on a specified parameter. It allows users to gain insights into servicing issues in the banking domain. By performing a GET request on the designated endpoint, developers can access detailed data that helps identify and address underlying problems in banking services. Typical consumers of this API include analysts and support teams who utilize the information to improve service quality and operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve Root Cause Analysis for a Specific Case
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the root cause analysis details for a specific case identified by its unique ID. It provides insights necessary for understanding the underlying issues related to the case, which can aid in effective decision-making and resolution.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the root cause analysis for the specified servicing case, identified by RES-100045. The JSON payload should conform to the defined schema to ensure accurate processing.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the case root cause analysis data.

GetServicingByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the root cause analysis operation in the servicing case.

GetServicingByParam1Response_200.title: Root Cause Analysis Response

customerId.description: The unique identifier of the customer.

caseId.description: The unique identifier of the case.

priority.description: The priority level of the case.

originatingChannel.description: The channel through which the request originated.

caseReason.description: The reason provided for the case.

serviceLevelDueAt.description: The date and time by which the service level commitment is due.

customerContactPreference.description: The preferred method of contact for the customer.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the case record.

version.description: The version number of the case record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the case record was last updated.
